name: Beken BK7259 SMP SDK
description: Pinned BK7259 SDK4.0.1 with GNU Arm14.3.1 and an offline x86 Python3.11 firmware-tool environment on Linux x86_64 and ARM64 guests.
notes: Candidate source 06cb0f2d9cdeab571ec5be2d54398c67e097a4cc retains recursive submodules and LFS. New release 4.0.1+g06cb0f2d.1 preserves the native Linux x86_64 recipe and adds an explicit Linux ARM64 recipe: original x86_64 Python3.11.18 and the same pinned x86 wheels run through guest binfmt/QEMU with linux-x86-runtime; GizMoth supplies QEMU_LD_PREFIX=/opt/gizmoth/x86_64. Native managed Python only generates lock inputs and checks Git cleanliness. The embedded x86 Python creates the venv and runs pip, imports and the read-only libcommon.so encrypt/xts_aes symbol check. Firmware-tool dependencies include vendored bk_py_libs, the Python OTA packager and hdrgen openpyxl/et_xmlfile. Installation and read-only Python/dependency/libcommon.so symbol checks passed in GizMoth's ARM64 Linux worker. Firmware packaging and AES/XTS operations remain unqualified. The older x86-only release remains immutable. Documentation tooling, invalid legacy convert_to_cmake.py and missing upstream legacy packager_tools/security executables remain outside this firmware-tool candidate. No vendor program was executed during registry validation.
